Players Committee card image of [[Yoda, Master Of The Force (V)]] (Virtual Set 13), March 2021 errata (card marked “E”), printing: “Power +3 while defending a battle (or while exactly two Jedi on table). Once per game, during your move phase, may relocate to an [Episode I] battleground site as a regular move. Immune to attrition.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2f0f28b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/hires/yodamasteroftheforce.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/hires/yodamasteroftheforce.png] as of commit 2f0f28b “2021 March Errata” (18 March 2021).
